sentences.text: This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.220/2018 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Jaiutpur on the ground that with the intervention of family and friends, the parties have settled their disputes and are now living together.
2. Respondent No.2-complainat and all the 6 petitioners and have joined the proceedings through VC with their counsel.
All of them have been duly identified by the IO who is present in the Court today.
3. On query raised by the Court, respondent No.2 has affirmed having arrived at settlement with the petitioners out of her own free will and volition and that she is now peacefully with them.
Her affidavit in this behalf is also on record as per which she has no objection if the afore-noted FIR is quashed qua the petitioners.

4. Considering the above settlement between the parties and chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use to continue with proceeding of the present FIR as the complainant has settled all disputes with the petitioner.
Consequently, the aforementioned FIR and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
5. Pending application is disposed of as infructuous 6.
Order be uploaded on website of this Court.
